capabilities: Chat with an agent that searches, reads and reasons over vault notes
Stream thinking traces and tool calls with clickable per-note citations
Publish a Q&A exchange as a revocable LAN web page with QR code
Index notes with embeddings and control re-indexing from a dashboard
Expose the same search tools as a local MCP server for other AI clients
disambiguation: Not a link-management or backlinks plugin; the name refers to semantic search over your notes.
extras: BYOK: the plugin itself adds no cost; users pay their own model providers or use key-less local runtimes like Ollama. Stores its index as SQLite and binary vector files in the plugin folder. Listed as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Semlink keeps the whole loop inside Obsidian: you see the thinking and every tool call
motivation: The author built it because most Obsidian AI plugins depend on third-party agent clients built for programming, and wanted an agent that works entirely inside the vault.
problem: Asking questions about your own notes means remembering folders, Ctrl+F, and pasting text into an external chat window, and most Obsidian AI plugins require separate agent clients to work.

relations.evidence: Copilot routes its agent through opencode and its RAG through Miyo — external tools
If you also use Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor, the same tools are exposed

requires.name: chat and embedding provider API key (OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint)

summary: Built-in AI agent that chats with your vault, searches notes semantically, answers with clickable citations, shares Q&A over LAN, and offers an optional MCP server.
